page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped directly to 16 physical cores, operating with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

For acceleration tasks, the instance integrates a single NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the inclusion of an older-generation NVIDIA P4 GPU positions this instance as a budget-friendly option for workloads requiring hardware acceleration without the premium cost of modern high-end GPUs. The dedicated CPU cores and balanced memory footprint make it suitable for entry-level machine learning inference, video transcoding, and lightweight graphics rendering workloads where parallel processing is required.

It is well-suited for tasks such as low-latency machine learning inference, video encoding, and basic parallel processing workloads that benefit from dedicated CPU resources and moderate GPU acceleration without the need for high-end, costly accelerator hardware.
